subject: SierraWare: procurement path & vendor onboarding next steps
messages:
From: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.ai>
To: Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.ai>, Rafael Mendes <rafael.mendes@redwood.ai>, Monica Patel <monica.patel@redwood.ai>
Date: Tue, 21 Jul 2026 09:05:00 -0700
Subject: SierraWare discovery recap — procurement constraints and quick wins

Team — quick recap from the call with SierraWare (Evan + Priya from finance). High level: they like the product fit for secure inference in their R&D pipelines but procurement has clear constraints that will determine our commercial path. Notes below and suggested next steps.

Key procurement points (direct from Evan/Priya):
- AP requires a vendor setup + PO for any recurring spend over $5k/month.
- One-off/low-value purchases (proof-of-concept credits, training bundles) can go on a corporate card but need CFO sign-off for anything over $3k.
- Marketplace (AWS/GCP marketplace) is of high interest — procurement said listing would expedite approvals because they can buy via their cloud contract and skip vendor onboarding.
- Vendor onboarding timeline: 4–6 weeks if they run through their standard vendor packet (W-9, company certs, banking details).

Technical/ops asks we should confirm:
- SSO + SCIM requirement for enterprise accounts (monica to confirm readiness).
- Data retention and audit log specifics (they asked for 12 months retention, audit logs accessible for compliance).

Sales play suggestions:
1) Short path: push marketplace listing as a pilot purchase → gets them live faster and bypasses vendor setup.
2) Parallel path: start vendor paperwork now (W-9, insurance, security questionnaires) so PO path is ready by the time pilot expands.
3) Offer an initial credit-based pilot (<$3k) on card to prove value while vendor onboarding runs.

Action items (owners):
- Marissa: share W-9 + draft quote and propose next steps to Evan (I will send now).
- Ben: prep a marketplace cost estimate / listing timeline (can we offer a transactable SKU?).
- Monica: produce SSO/retention one-pager for their security team.
- Rafael: prepare finance note for net-30 invoice option if they demand PO (decide if legal needs contract amendment).

I'll reach out to Evan with the W-9 and a recommended next-step plan.

Marissa
Marissa Cole | Sr. Enterprise AE | Redwood Inference

Hi Evan / Priya — thanks again for the time this morning. Per our conversation I’ve attached our W-9 and a short pilot quote to help you evaluate options. Summary of recommended approaches:

1) Fastest to value: pilot via marketplace (if you can purchase through AWS/GCP contract) — no vendor setup required on your side and we can get you live in days.
2) Parallel: start vendor onboarding paperwork now (W-9 attached). If procurement runs the packet we expect 4–6 weeks to be vendor-approved for PO-based billing.
3) Short-term trial: we can provision a credit-based pilot on your corporate card under $3k to demonstrate value while the vendor paperwork proceeds.

Could you confirm which path you prefer? If you’d like the marketplace route I can loop in Ben and our marketplace team to check SKU availability and pricing. If procurement prefers vendor setup / PO, can Priya share the vendor packet checklist so we can pre-fill what we can?

Thanks — happy to hop on a quick 15-min call to walk through the options.

Best,

Marissa — appreciate the quick follow-up and the attachments. A few clarifications from our end: 

- Procurement preference: PO + vendor setup for any recurring relationship. They will accept a card for a small pilot but need CFO approval for spend > $3k.
- Marketplace: yes, very attractive. Please have Ben send the marketplace SKU/pricing and an estimated go-live timeline. Our procurement team indicated marketplace purchases can be completed in 2–3 business days if the SKU is available.
- Vendor packet: Priya attached our vendor checklist (see below). We need a completed W-9, proof of insurance, and a primary POC for vendor setup.

Can you confirm: do you support invoicing net-30 on a PO currently? If so, what is the required paperwork and internal SLA?

Thanks — Evan

Evan / Marissa — looping in marketplace onboarding to confirm SKUs and timelines. Quick answers to your invoicing question:

- Redwood can do net-30 invoicing on an approved PO. Standard process: vendor setup -> signed MSA (or PO referencing SOW) -> finance creates vendor record -> invoice. Typical timeline once vendor packet is complete: 3–5 business days for invoice processing.
- If you want faster time-to-value, marketplace purchase is the fastest. If the SKU is in the public marketplace, procurement buys directly and we appear as the vendor on their cloud bill. That path avoids our vendor packet entirely.
- For the pilot-on-card option: we can provision an account and cap spend to <$3k to avoid CFO escalation.

Hi Evan — quick technical note to support procurement/security review.

- SSO: Redwood supports SAML 2.0 and SCIM for provisioning. We can stand up an SSO integration in <5 business days for pilot accounts; for org-wide rollouts we recommend SCIM provisioning which takes ~2 weeks for initial setup and testing.
- Retention & logs: we can produce 12 months of message-level audit logs and configurable retention windows. We can provide an export of audit logs for compliance review on request.
- Security docs: happy to provide SOC 2 summary + our standard security brief. Rafael — please attach Security summary and SOC 2 link to the packet.

If procurement wants completed vendor paperwork, please send the vendor packet back to marissa.cole@redwood.ai and we will prioritize return of all requested docs.

Thanks,
Monica Patel | Customer Success Engineer | Redwood Inference
